Verifier notes and special checks

One page, five grand-staff systems, forty-eight printed regions in 2/4. System 1 opens treble over bass with 2/4 and no key signature. P001 is a one-eighth opening pickup: a right-hand eighth with a sharp accidental under p against a left-hand eighth rest. P002 through P017 are complete 2/4 bars. At the start of P018 both staves print a new three-sharp key signature before the mf music. System 3 reprints that three-sharp signature at the clefs; that reprint is not a new change. P029 is a three-eighth first-section ending: on both staves a dotted-quarter line against three moving eighths, closed by a light-light double bar, then three cancellation naturals on each staff. P030 is a one-eighth second-section pickup under p with no key signature after the restored 0-sharp key. P031 through P047 are complete 2/4 bars. P048 is a three-eighth terminal under pp: one sounding eighth in each staff followed by two eighth rests, closed by a thin-thick final barline. P001 with P029 and P030 with P048 each pair to one printed 2/4 bar. No repeats, endings, mid-piece clef changes, or meter changes. All five red crop-boundary overlays keep the musical ink inside; system 1 keeps title and tempo, system 5 keeps plate 41459.
